summary: Antelope Enterprise Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of a $6,000,000 convertible promissory note to Stratosphere Capital Management Inc., an accredited investor, plus up to 12,000,000 Class A ordinary shares issuable on conversion. The note purchase agreement is dated September 10, 2026; no placement agent was used. AEHL closed at $6.07 on September 14, 2026. This is a routine registered note-and-underlying-shares takedown, not a special situation; the implied conversion price and any discount are not stated. Watch for dilution and resale overhang risks.
